Section 2.4 counts, files_sha256, two-capture bitwise identity, legacy 112/untouched, captured_at, tag, scope, dual-camera 10-field snapshots, resolved plan and cam_active all hold. Refit sequence refit-render-refit-render with 2/2 and exit 0, wall 2.02 s; environment and zero-compile/tree states recorded. The authoring exception is compliant: regular monitor failed (longest_clean 22, util max 43) before the pre-approved util<60 rerun gave 60/60 clean, util 14-40, compute_filtered=0, build=0, exception_load_bearing=true, floor not relaxed (every clean sample free >= 10,230).
